# Webamazee

> Webamazee is an AI-powered digital marketing and web development company that builds fast, SEO-ready websites and runs data-driven search, content and social media campaigns. Headquartered in Mohali, Punjab, India, the company serves clients worldwide.

Core expertise: Website Development, E-Commerce Development, Website Redesign, Landing Pages, SEO, Technical SEO, Local SEO, AI SEO and AI Content Optimization, Social Media Management, Social Media Marketing and Paid Social Advertising, plus Branding and Graphic Design packages.

## Services

- [Website Development](https://www.webamazee.com/services/website-development): Custom, responsive business websites engineered for speed, SEO and conversions.
- [E-Commerce Development](https://www.webamazee.com/services/ecommerce-development): Checkout-optimised, SEO-ready online stores built to turn browsers into buyers.
- [Website Redesign](https://www.webamazee.com/services/website-redesign): Modernising existing websites to improve performance, UX and conversions while protecting search visibility.
- [Landing Page Development](https://www.webamazee.com/services/landing-page-development): Focused, high-converting landing pages built around ads, offers and campaign goals.
- [SEO Services](https://www.webamazee.com/services/seo-services): Full-funnel SEO combining technical, on-page and off-page optimisation.
- [Technical SEO](https://www.webamazee.com/services/technical-seo): Crawlability, Core Web Vitals and site architecture optimisation for search engines.
- [Local SEO](https://www.webamazee.com/services/local-seo): Google Maps and local search optimisation to win nearby customers and calls.
- [Link Building](https://www.webamazee.com/services/link-building): White-hat, authoritative backlinks that strengthen domain power and rankings.
- [Competitor Analysis](https://www.webamazee.com/services/competitor-analysis): Reverse-engineering competitor strategies to find gaps and opportunities.
- [Google Ranking Growth](https://www.webamazee.com/services/google-ranking-growth): A measurable system for moving websites up Google's rankings.

## AI & Marketing

- [AI SEO](https://www.webamazee.com/services/ai-seo): AI-driven content and search-intent optimisation designed to rank ahead of competitors.

- [Social Media Management](https://www.webamazee.com/services/social-media-management): Complete management of brand presence, content, posting and engagement across major platforms.
- [Social Media Marketing](https://www.webamazee.com/services/social-media-marketing): Strategic campaigns to increase reach, engagement and business growth.
- [Social Media Advertising](https://www.webamazee.com/services/social-media-advertising): Paid social campaigns built to reach the right audience and maximise performance.
- [Instagram Marketing](https://www.webamazee.com/services/instagram-marketing): Instagram-focused strategies, content and campaigns for audience growth and engagement.
- [Facebook Marketing](https://www.webamazee.com/services/facebook-marketing): Facebook strategies to reach target audiences and generate leads.
- [LinkedIn Marketing](https://www.webamazee.com/services/linkedin-marketing): LinkedIn strategies for B2B visibility, authority and lead generation.
